summary: Expiry is immediate and no new evidence is possible, so this points at the retained draft without claiming new work. Final recorded state: the snapshot is unmodified upstream etcd-raft v3.7.0 at commit b867cf13; all necessary gaps are closed and no questions remain open; six threads are recorded, two asserted as sourced defects with retained executions and four explained or refuted with explicit boundaries. The asserted defects are read-index retry growth, where per-request context-blind admission accumulates queued or unconfirmed entries with no library-side bound or reclamation while the process lives and releases them as a burst of one admission plus one heartbeat per entry, measured across the queued path, the admitted path, the release burst, a CheckQuorum control, a byte measurement of caller payload and an isolated-leader network run that also corrected the amplification to one heartbeat per peer per retry; and the configuration change, where an empty ConfChangeV2 whose transition is not Auto in a joint configuration passes propose-time validation as an EntryConfChangeV2, commits in a real three-node network, and panics the application in ApplyConfChange with config is already joint, with the Auto form as the working control and the pending-conf guard as a precondition. The remaining threads cover readOnly ack validation as out of contract, queued read requests kept fresh across term changes, the StateSnapshot repair duty with both exits observed, and proposer eligibility of removed members resting with the caller under the documented MsgProp contract.
